SELECT subject_id, object_id FROM module_depends_on_module LIMIT 20
SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id='package:fx03-legacy'
SELECT subject_id, object_id FROM service_implements_module ORDER BY subject_id

SELECT m.subject_id, m.object_id 
FROM module_depends_on_module m
JOIN service_implements_module s ON s.object_id = m.subject_id
ORDER BY s.subject_id
LIMIT 30

WITH RECURSIVE dep_on_package AS (
  SELECT subject_id AS module_id
  FROM module_depends_on_package
  WHERE object_id = 'package:fx03-legacy'
  UNION
  SELECT m.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module m
  JOIN dep_on_package d ON m.object_id = d.module_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.id
FROM services s
JOIN service_implements_module sim ON sim.subject_id = s.id
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = s.id
JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id
JOIN task_retires_package trp ON trp.subject_id = ttd.subject_id
JOIN dep_on_package dop ON dop.module_id = sim.object_id
WHERE ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx03-cutover'
  AND trp.object_id = 'package:fx03-legacy'
ORDER BY s.id

WITH RECURSIVE dep_on_package AS (
      SELECT subject_id AS module_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx03-legacy'
      UNION
      SELECT m.subject_id FROM module_depends_on_module m JOIN dep_on_package d ON m.object_id = d.module_id
    ),
    svc_module AS (SELECT object_id AS module_id FROM service_implements_module WHERE subject_id = ?)
    SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dep_on_package d JOIN svc_module s ON d.module_id = s.module_id) THEN 'affected' ELSE 'not affected' END
